# Entity Existence

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:EntityExistence`](gmeow-EntityExistence.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/EntityExistence>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lifecycle`](../../slices/lifecycle.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reified, time-scoped fact that an entity existed over an interval — a [gufo:Situation](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Situation) that carries its period via [`gmeow:duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md) (inherited from [`TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)). Use when the existence claim is contested (two sources disagree on when a place ceased to exist), when evidence must be attached, or when standpoint indexing is needed. Flat-first: the common case uses [`gmeow:hasCreationEvent`](../properties/gmeow-hasCreationEvent.md) / [`gmeow:hasDestructionEvent`](../properties/gmeow-hasDestructionEvent.md) / [`gmeow:existenceInterval`](../properties/gmeow-existenceInterval.md) directly on the entity.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:EntityExistence`](gmeow-EntityExistence.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use the reified form when the existence claim itself must carry standpoint, confidence, evidence, or contestation — two sources disagreeing on when a place ceased to exist, or a dated founding needing a citation.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the ordinary case — flat [`gmeow:hasCreationEvent`](../properties/gmeow-hasCreationEvent.md) / [`gmeow:hasDestructionEvent`](../properties/gmeow-hasDestructionEvent.md) / [`gmeow:existenceInterval`](../properties/gmeow-existenceInterval.md) on the entity carry it more cheaply; promote to this relator only when the claim needs to be argued about.

### How to use

- Mint a [`gmeow:EntityExistence`](gmeow-EntityExistence.md), attach the subject with [`gmeow:existenceEntity`](../properties/gmeow-existenceEntity.md), the bounding events with gmeow:existenceCreationEvent/existenceDestructionEvent, the period via the inherited [`gmeow:duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md), and standpoint/evidence via the statement layer.

### Examples

- ex:troyExistence a [`gmeow:EntityExistence`](gmeow-EntityExistence.md); [`gmeow:existenceEntity`](../properties/gmeow-existenceEntity.md) ex:troy; [`gmeow:existenceDestructionEvent`](../properties/gmeow-existenceDestructionEvent.md) ex:sack; [`gmeow:accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md) ex:homer.
